display.purpose: One per page; hero headline. Orbitron, solid white.

title.purpose: Card, service, promotion titles; TypeRows at weight 900.

label.purpose: Uppercase captions, indexes, form legends. Never a kicker above a heading.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 8px); background: var(--color-primary, #D9161E); color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-sans, Rajdhani, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgb(237 28 36 / 0.6); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #FF2D35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-primary-active, #B01117); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000, 0 0 0 4px #ED1C24; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Black fill with a grey stroke; turns surface with a white stroke on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #333333; background: #000; color: #fff; font-family: var(--font-sans, Rajdhani, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #fff; background: #111111; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #161616; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000, 0 0 0 4px #ED1C24; }

components.name: Link Button

components.css: .ds-btn-link { color: #FF4D53; font-family: var(--font-sans, Rajdhani, sans-serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000, 0 0 0 4px #ED1C24; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
A repair counter at night: true black ground, one hard brand red, white headline type, and photographs of the work itself under a lamp. The site sells speed and competence, so it shows the trade (screens lifted, batteries fitted, boards under the microscope) and sets its claims in wide, solid Orbitron. Everything a person reads or presses is in Rajdhani.

Density is generous: sections breathe on a fluid 64 to 128px vertical rhythm, headers split heading-left / intro-right on desktop, and short lists are set as type rather than boxed. Depth is tonal (a ladder of near-blacks) plus offset shadows; there is no glass translucency outside the sticky header.

Confirmed rejections (owner): no hollow or outlined headline text, no scan-line or texture over headlines. Headlines are solid, bold, white.
keyCharacteristics: True black (#000) page, near-black ladder for sections and panels.
One accent: brand red. One full-red field per page at most.
Orbitron headlines (solid white), Rajdhani for body, buttons, labels and questions.
Generated photographs of repair work, always captioned as what they show.
Ruled rows and type-set lists over card grids.

rules.name: The One Red Field Rule
rules.body: A page carries at most one full-bleed red section (home: Promotions). Elsewhere red is an accent, never a ground.

rules.name: The Opaque Token Rule
rules.body: Colour tokens are CSS variables, so Tailwind opacity modifiers on them (`bg-primary/20`, `border-border/50`) silently fail. For translucency use `black/xx` or `white/xx` (e.g. the `white/30` rules on the red field), or the pre-mixed tint tokens.

rules.name: The Solid Headline Rule
rules.body: Headlines are solid bold white. No outline/hollow text, no scan-line, gradient-fill or texture on headline type.

rules.name: The Reading Face Rule
rules.body: Orbitron is for headlines and figures only. Buttons, labels, captions, nav, form text and FAQ questions are Rajdhani.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: The tag style is for captions and indexes, never as a label above a heading. The single exception is the home hero's red "Speedy iRepair" brand line, which stays red and is not reused elsewhere.

rules.name: The Falling Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows have a y-offset and negative spread; no centred halo glows on boxes.

rules.name: The Solid Chrome Rule
rules.body: `glass` panels are solid (#0c0c0c, 1px #222 border), and so is the sticky header (solid black, hairline rule). No backdrop blur on panels or chrome.

dos: Do set headlines in solid bold white Orbitron, and everything read or pressed in Rajdhani.
Do keep the home hero brand line "Speedy iRepair" red.
Do start side-by-side layouts at `md:` (768) or later.
Do use `black/xx` or `white/xx` for translucency; token colours do not take opacity modifiers.
Do build sections with `Section`, alternating `default` and `raised` tones.
Do pair inner-page hero headlines with one photograph from the site image set, captioned with what it shows.
Do set name-only lists as TypeRows.
Do put every third-party embed behind a click-to-load facade with a backdrop and a compact idle height.
donts: Don't use hollow/outlined text, scan-lines or textures on headlines.
Don't use `sm:` for multi-column layouts; `sm` is a 375px phone.
Don't run more than one full-red field on a page.
Don't present the generated photographs as this shop, its bench, team or storefront.
Don't box short name lists in cards.
Don't show prices on repair or trade-in services (Shopify product prices are allowed).
Don't place tag-style labels above headings as kickers.
Don't use zero-offset halo shadows or backdrop blur on panels or chrome.
